baseline_models.reading: A creator brought the human being, generically humankind, into being from عَلَقٍ: materially, thick or congealed blood.

focus_anchor.role: The transitive creation verb makes humankind its object, while مِنْ introduces the material of origin.

activation_trace.role: The scope includes bringing something into being from something else, fitting the expressed material source.
The human-presence scope includes الإنسان for a person or humankind.
The thick or congealed blood portion of this paired blood/leech scope supplies the material reading.

baseline_models.mechanism: An accomplished act of making relates a named human outcome to an indefinite material beginning. The human is the recipient of this act, rather than its stated agent.
baseline_models.reader_inference: The lexical senses are packet-supplied; generic reference and the source construction are ordinary grammatical readings. No further causal assumption is needed. The same blood branch includes the leech, but its presence does not establish an animal progenitor.
baseline_models.containment: Preserve this ordinary material reading. The isolated focus does not name its implicit subject or specify a biological timetable, an exact modern developmental stage, or the number of blood pieces.

baseline_models.reading: Within that biological origin, عَلَقٍ can foreground clinging and conception taking hold: the human beginning is attachment-bearing material.

focus_anchor.role: The source noun carries an attachment image alongside its blood-related material sense.

activation_trace.role: Clinging, sticking, and hanging on another thing make relation to something else salient.
The pregnancy and conception-taking-hold scope brings the attachment image specifically into biological generation.

structural_cues.role: Human origination makes the reproductive attachment scope relevant to the source phrase.

baseline_models.mechanism: The origin construction connects human formation with a source characterized by holding or taking hold. This changes the emphasis from the consistency of blood to the relational character of a biological beginning.
baseline_models.reader_inference: Both attachment and conception are supplied lexical scopes. Relating the conception scope to this noun is licensed by the human-creation construction, although the branch also contains other derived forms. Extending such initial attachment into lifelong psychological or moral dependence would require another inference.
baseline_models.containment: Keep this close image reading beside the material reading. Do not turn the source phrase into a universal definition of humans as attachments, or infer a specified attachment site or modern embryological mechanism.

context_deltas.reading: The creator in the focus is the addressee's Lord; human creation specifies the creative act that accompanies the command to read in his name.

focus_anchor.role: This repeated creation verb supplies the particular human object after the preceding relative clause.

activation_trace.role: Lordship and authority identify the relation of the antecedent to the addressed reader.

structural_cues.role: The command introduces the Lord as the one who created.
Repeating خَلَقَ elaborates that relative clause with human creation and its material source.

context_deltas.mechanism: Lexical repetition across the ayah boundary and the continuing implicit subject resolve the focus's creator. The origin statement becomes part of the address authorizing reading.

changed_reading.before: An unnamed creator makes humankind from عَلَقٍ.
changed_reading.after: That creator is the addressed reader's Lord, and this human origin helps frame the command to read in his name.

context_deltas.reader_inference: Subject continuity follows ordinary syntax and sequence. Treating the creator-description as a warrant for the command is a rhetorical inference; no historical identity or occasion is needed.
context_deltas.containment: The focus specifies human creation. It does not say that every possible object of the preceding unrestricted خَلَقَ was made from عَلَقٍ.

context_deltas.reading: The human made from عَلَقٍ is also the human taught what he did not know. Material origination becomes the first term in a sequence of received care and enabling generosity.

focus_anchor.role: The human as object of creation is repeated as object of teaching.

activation_trace.role: Care, nurture, and completion supply a fitting image for the connection between making and teaching.
The nobility and generosity scope characterizes the Lord who subsequently teaches.
The writing instrument makes the extension from bodily origin to learned capacities concrete.
The complete occurrence row includes teaching and the prior absence of knowing, placing knowledge on the receiving side.

structural_cues.role: The human first appears as a made being with a material beginning.
The repeated reading command identifies the Lord through surpassing generosity or excellence.
A new relative clause identifies this Lord through teaching by the pen.
The repeated verb-object pattern links the created human to the taught human.

context_deltas.mechanism: Parallel خَلَقَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ and عَلَّمَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ join biological and epistemic reception under one Lord. The description ٱلْأَكْرَمُ gives that continuity a beneficent valuation.

changed_reading.before: The focus reports the material beginning of human existence.
changed_reading.after: That beginning belongs to a relation in which both existence and previously absent knowledge are received.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The repetition, teaching, and pen are explicit. Reading them as continuous care draws on the supplied nurture scope and the order of presentation; the passage does not narrate every developmental stage or say that teaching causes the later transgression.
context_deltas.containment: Keep the generosity beside the humbling material origin. Neither عَلَقٍ nor the contrast with learning warrants calling the human worthless, and the pen clause does not state that all knowledge is acquired through writing.

context_deltas.reading: The created, initially attached human is precisely the human who can regard himself as self-sufficient. The origin statement becomes a rebuttal to that self-assessment.

focus_anchor.role: The recurring human noun and its dependent beginning supply the counterweight to later independence.

activation_trace.role: Clinging to another thing sharpens the contrast with lack of need.
Overstepping in rebellion supplies the conduct associated with the self-assessment.
Judgment or supposition makes this an estimate of oneself, not an independent demonstration of sufficiency.
Wealth, means, and reduced or absent need provide the live range of the claimed sufficiency.

structural_cues.role: The first human statement assigns existence to an act and a source outside the human's own agency.
The emphatic turn repeats the same generic human designation with transgression.
The causal construction associates transgression with seeing oneself as sufficient.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repetition makes the contrast internal to one human category: a received and attached origin is followed by an appraisal of independence. The causal clause locates the immediate problem in that appraisal.

changed_reading.before: Attachment describes the human's biological beginning.
changed_reading.after: Remembering that beginning exposes the limitation of the human's later claim to self-sufficiency.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The text supplies the repeated noun and causal sequence. The self-referential reading of رَّءَاهُ is an ordinary construction. Extending material dependence into a rebuttal of existential independence is rhetorical inference; financial sufficiency remains a live, narrower sense of ٱسْتَغْنَىٰٓ.
context_deltas.containment: Do not translate عَلَقٍ as poverty or infer that wealth mechanically causes rebellion. Generic warning does not make transgression the unavoidable behavior of every created person.

context_deltas.reading: Human origin is the opening of a trajectory whose return is to the same Lord; creation cannot be treated as a dependence left entirely in the past.

focus_anchor.role: The act and material beginning acquire a subsequent direction of return.

activation_trace.role: Return to a prior place, owner, or relation supplies a directed continuation beyond initial creation.

structural_cues.role: The Lord is introduced through creation.
The focus supplies the human beginning.
The same addressed Lord is the emphatically stated destination.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated رَبِّكَ connects the creator with the return destination. The movement from a statement of origin to إِلَىٰ supplies a temporal and relational frame around human independence.

changed_reading.before: The focus describes a completed beginning from material.
changed_reading.after: That beginning is read within an ongoing relation ending in return to the Lord who created.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The return destination and repeated Lord designation are explicit; reading the origin and return as a framing trajectory is supplied by the reader. No assumption that source matter and destination are identical is needed.
context_deltas.containment: مِنْ names عَلَقٍ, whereas إِلَىٰ names the Lord. Do not infer that humans originate from divine substance or that return means physically becoming blood again. The mode and timing of return are not specified here.

context_deltas.reading: Creation from عَلَقٍ identifies a common human beginning without exhausting human moral possibilities: the later scene contains prayer and guidance as well as obstruction and transgression.

focus_anchor.role: The generic human category can contain the differently evaluated persons or possible conduct in the later scene.

activation_trace.role: Worship and submissive obedience fit the servant's praying and provide an enacted acknowledgment of dependence.
Moral self-guarding makes restraint a possible human orientation beside overstepping.

structural_cues.role: Generic creation precedes distinctions of human conduct.
A human is introduced through forbidding.
The object of the prohibition is another person engaged in prayer.
The conditional introduces the possibility of guided conduct.
Commanding protective moral restraint supplies another positively evaluated possibility.

context_deltas.mechanism: A common origin is followed by a differentiated social scene. Material creaturehood consequently cannot be collapsed into a single inevitable ethical disposition; dependence can be acknowledged in worship or contradicted by obstructive authority.

changed_reading.before: The focus names humankind collectively through its material beginning.
changed_reading.after: That collective origin remains common while the context distinguishes the conduct of particular humans and their possible responses.

context_deltas.reader_inference: Applying generic ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ to both participants is an ordinary category inference. The conditional subject in 96:11–12 can be read as the praying servant or as a test of the prohibiter's possible conduct; either leaves ethically different human possibilities live.
context_deltas.containment: The focus does not assign guilt at biological origin. The prayer setting supports the devotional servant sense without proving a particular civil slave status or naming either participant.

context_deltas.reading: The created human's reality cannot be settled by his own estimate of himself: the later reminder that Allah sees places the being of the focus under an assessment beyond self-regard.

focus_anchor.role: The human is already the object of an act whose reality does not depend on his self-description.

activation_trace.role: The judgment scope locates apparent sufficiency in the human's assessment.
Seeing or discerning is now predicated of Allah, reversing who supplies the decisive view.
The knowledge question calls the human to recognize that external seeing.

structural_cues.role: The focus states an origin rather than reporting a human opinion about it.
Earlier seeing is directed into a self-sufficiency assessment.
Denial and turning away make the subsequent seeing reminder concern answerable conduct.
The human is asked to know that Allah sees.

context_deltas.mechanism: The recurring seeing root changes its subject from the self-assessing human to Allah. This makes the focus's created identity a reality to recognize, rather than something self-regard can cancel.

changed_reading.before: Human origin counters the content of a claim to independence.
changed_reading.after: It also counters the claim of self-regard to be the final authority about the human and his conduct.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The shift in who sees and the knowledge question are explicit. Reading the creation statement as a correction of self-knowledge connects those statements rhetorically; 96:14 does not explicitly name the origin as the object of seeing.
context_deltas.containment: Do not replace material creation with a theory of perception, or supply a physical mechanism for divine seeing. This is an epistemic consequence for reading the human origin, not a new account of how it occurred.

context_deltas.reading: The human whose origin contradicts independence later appears dependent on an assembly for backing. Creation from عَلَقٍ gains a social application: organized human support does not remove creaturely limitation.

focus_anchor.role: The common made origin undercuts treating a human's acquired social power as absolute.

activation_trace.role: The assembly and gathered people provide the concrete social backing being summoned.
Calling others toward oneself exposes reliance on assistance.
The answering summons establishes a competing source of force.
The pushing and repelling scope gives the counter-summons coercive force; it does not supply a detailed identity for those summoned.

structural_cues.role: Human beings begin as recipients of creation.
The earlier apparent independence is tested by needing a group.
The challenge gives the individual an assembly to call.
A matching call answers and contests that social resource.

context_deltas.mechanism: The symmetry of the two summons exposes the social infrastructure behind apparent individual sufficiency. Read back through generic human creation, the assembly also consists of beings whose acquired power does not erase their origin.

changed_reading.before: The origin statement rebuts independence at a general individual level.
changed_reading.after: Its rebuttal also reaches the human's reliance on an assembly and the claim that such backing confers immunity.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The two calls and the council sense are supplied. Construing the assembly as sought backing follows the challenge; applying generic humanity to its members is a reader's category inference. These are threatened or proposed summons, not a narrated battle with a reported outcome.
context_deltas.containment: Do not make all companionship blameworthy, identify a historical council, or treat عَلَقٍ as the literal name of a political network.

context_deltas.reading: The human's received origin can be acknowledged through prostration and approach while the prohibiting human is disobeyed. Creaturely dependence supports a directed response with agency.

focus_anchor.role: The human who receives existence is later addressed as someone capable of refusing, prostrating, and approaching.

activation_trace.role: The compliance scope is explicitly negated toward the human prohibiter.
Prostration and humble submission give an embodied acknowledgment of the relation to the Lord.
Devotional approach fits the imperative paired with prostration.

structural_cues.role: Humanity is initially described as the object of creation.
The earlier prohibiting person supplies the natural antecedent of the disobedience instruction.
Prayer identifies the activity being obstructed.
A refusal of one person's command is joined to active submission and approach.

context_deltas.mechanism: The passage moves from the human as grammatical object of creation to imperatives addressed to a human agent. Dependence is given an orientation: it can ground worship without licensing obedience to the obstructer.

changed_reading.before: The focus emphasizes receiving existence and beginning in attachment.
changed_reading.after: That dependence can be consciously acknowledged through a chosen bodily response while resisting another human's interference.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The closing commands are explicit. Applying the generic creation statement to the addressee and reading the commands as a fitting acknowledgment of origin are rhetorical inferences. The Lord-directed sense of approach follows the prayer setting; the imperative alone leaves its object unstated.
context_deltas.containment: Do not infer passive obedience to every authority from creaturehood. The command provides a response to origin; it does not claim that every human will make that response or that devotional nearness is physical fusion.

surprising_valid_outliers.reading: The human's formation from a conception that takes hold can resonate with another kind of formation through reading: the inventory places a womb-enclosing image inside the root of the commands surrounding the focus.

focus_anchor.role: The reproductive attachment sense supplies the biological side of the analogy.

activation_trace.role: Reading and reciting remain the ordinary force of the command.
The related scope of a womb enclosing blood, fetus, or pregnancy supplies a reproductive echo, especially in its animal examples.
Conception taking hold meets the enclosing-pregnancy image in the nearby reading root.

structural_cues.role: The first command directly introduces creation.
The biological beginning stands between two reading commands.
The repeated imperative closes that immediate frame.
The same human subsequently receives knowledge, giving the analogy a concrete second form of becoming.

surprising_valid_outliers.mechanism: The close reading–creation–reading sequence places an attested reproductive image of ق ر ء beside the reproductive image of ع ل ق. The created-and-taught human can consequently be pictured as receiving bodily and intellectual formation.

changed_reading.before: Conception taking hold describes only the human's bodily beginning.
changed_reading.after: That beginning can provide an image for the formation of a reader through received instruction.

surprising_valid_outliers.reader_inference: The two lexical scopes and their textual proximity are supplied. A gestation analogy for learning is reader-created; the passage does not call learning a second birth. The ordinary reading commands and the biological statement remain sufficient without this echo.
surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because an animal-pregnancy scope participates in a reading command's root. It remains anchored by the neighboring human conception and repeated reading commands, but must not replace ٱقْرَأْ with a command to conceive or turn dictionary association into an asserted etymological argument.

surprising_valid_outliers.reading: Alongside the humbling material beginning, the cherished-object branch of ع ل ق permits a resonance of human value under the most generous Lord: a being associated with clinging can also be regarded as worth cherishing.

focus_anchor.role: The juxtaposition of the human and the attachment-root source can carry a secondary valuation without altering the material syntax.

activation_trace.role: The precious object guarded or clung to supplies value attached to the root's holding relation.
Generosity and honoring establish a nearby positive valuation.
The related dear or valued person/thing scope specifically meets the cherished-object scope of ع ل ق.

structural_cues.role: The focus states origin without itself calling its human outcome contemptible.
The adjacent praise modifies the Lord associated with that creation.
The human receives a concrete benefit, making the proposed valuing direction plausible.

surprising_valid_outliers.mechanism: The shared value scopes allow attachment to be viewed from the side of cherishing rather than solely needing support. Generous teaching provides a contextual reason to try that reversal.

changed_reading.before: The source material says little by itself about the human's value.
changed_reading.after: A secondary lexical echo lets received existence and instruction suggest a valued beneficiary alongside an initially dependent one.

surprising_valid_outliers.reader_inference: The cherished-object and valued-person scopes are supplied. Transferring their valuation to the human beneficiary is the reader's directional assumption: ٱلْأَكْرَمُ explicitly describes the Lord, not the human. Generosity can be read without activating this additional valuation.
surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The surprising move is from a blood-related source to cherishing. It is anchored in two supplied value scopes and the gift of teaching, but related lexical uses do not establish that the vocalized عَلَقٍ here means treasure, jewels, or a divinely named precious object.

surprising_valid_outliers.reading: The creation of the human can acquire a craft image when teaching by the pen follows it: a formed human receives knowledge through an instrument itself shaped and pared for its work.

focus_anchor.role: The creation root supplies the possible image of measured formation.

activation_trace.role: Measuring or proportioning before cutting or acting supplies a craft process, not an asserted biological operation.
Visible, completed, proportioned form gives the human an outcome of formation.
Paring or trimming a hard thing supplies the instrument's shaping image.
The trimmed writing reed or pen joins that shaping image to the actual teaching instrument.

structural_cues.role: Human formation is presented through an outcome and its starting material.
The later benefit reaches the human through a shaped instrument.
Repeating the human object ties the pen's work to the recipient of creation.

surprising_valid_outliers.mechanism: Measuring and forming in خ ل ق meet trimming in ق ل م. The shared human object of creation and teaching prevents this from being merely a comparison of two unrelated tools or materials.

changed_reading.before: The focus describes bringing the human into existence from material.
changed_reading.after: It can also suggest a fashioned recipient whose further capacities develop through a fashioned means of teaching.

surprising_valid_outliers.reader_inference: The craft scopes and creation/teaching parallel are supplied. Comparing bodily and intellectual formation is a reader's analogy; the text does not describe an actual cutting process in human creation, and the pen remains a teaching instrument.
surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The surprise is the workshop-like link between human formation and pen preparation. Both lexical ends are anchored, but do not assert that عَلَقٍ is literally carved, that creation employs a pen here, or that physical proportion guarantees moral completeness.

surprising_valid_outliers.reading: The later transgressing human can evoke a material reversal of the focus: blood first pictured as thick or held together becomes, in the transgression root's image range, a force that surges beyond its measure.

focus_anchor.role: The blood-related origin supplies the specific material carried into the proposed reversal.

activation_trace.role: The thick or congealed blood component supplies relatively held-together material; the paired leech sense is not doing the work.
The scope explicitly includes blood, besides water and other forces, rising beyond measure or overwhelming.
Rebellious overstepping remains the ordinary contextual sense onto which the fluid image is projected.

structural_cues.role: The first human statement supplies the blood-related beginning.
The repeated human noun carries the possible material reversal into its transgressing predicate.
The text's stated cause concerns perceived sufficiency, containing the physiological analogy.

surprising_valid_outliers.mechanism: The blood material shared by the two supplied scopes, together with repeated ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ, permits a contrast between held material and exceeding bounds. The physical motion pictures the later ethical excess.

changed_reading.before: Blood characterizes an origin without a subsequent motion image.
changed_reading.after: The origin can become the first side of a held-blood/overflowing-blood contrast that makes human overstepping vivid.

surprising_valid_outliers.reader_inference: Blood in both scopes is packet-supplied. Treating them as a staged contrast is reader-created, and no literal transition between those blood states is narrated. The ordinary ethical account through self-assessment remains fully live.
surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The surprising cross-domain move is from blood consistency to moral excess. It is anchored in an explicit shared material and repeated human subject, but must remain an image, never a physiological explanation of rebellion or a claim that the source material is culpable.

surprising_valid_outliers.reading: The human actually created from عَلَقٍ can be contrasted with a merely pictured human in self-regard. The focus root's small human image in the eye gives an unusual visual form to the later claim to see oneself as sufficient.

focus_anchor.role: The ordinary human referent has a supplied neighboring ocular-image use, allowing a real-person/pictured-person contrast.

activation_trace.role: The small human-like image seen in the black of the eye supplies the pictured-person side of the analogy.
The appearance and mirror scope gives a visual idiom for a represented self, without asserting a literal mirror in the scene.
Judgment and supposition keep the actual self-sufficiency construction cognitive.

structural_cues.role: The human in the focus has an asserted material origin outside an act of self-regard.
The self-directed seeing furnishes the specific contextual invitation to imagine a self-image.
Seeing beyond the human's self-estimate prevents that pictured self from having final authority.

surprising_valid_outliers.mechanism: An ocular-image use of the focus noun meets self-directed seeing and an attested mirror/appearance scope in the later root. This lets the actual made human and the imagined sufficient human become contrasting visual figures.

changed_reading.before: ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ denotes the human brought into being from material.
changed_reading.after: That actual human can be distinguished from the human pictured by self-regard, whose appearance of sufficiency cannot undo the origin.

surprising_valid_outliers.reader_inference: The ocular and mirror scopes are supplied; constructing this visual contrast is the reader's move. The text names no mirror and does not say that a person literally views his own image in his own pupil. A purely cognitive reading of رَّءَاهُ is sufficient.
surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The surprising anchor is an ocular use of the focus noun, activated by actual self-seeing language. Keep it as a contained analogy: it neither translates ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ as pupil in this ayah nor gives bodily anatomy to Allah's seeing.

surprising_valid_outliers.reading: Initial attachment can become the first image in a bodily contrast: the human may be forcibly held by the forelock, while the closing addressee is invited to lower the forehead in prostration. Bodily dependence admits coercive and willing orientations.

focus_anchor.role: Clinging to another thing supplies the initial bodily relation to be re-imagined through the later head imagery.

activation_trace.role: Clinging or hanging makes a body's relation to another support or hold salient.
Seizing the front of the head supplies an explicitly coercive hold.
Forelock pulling and figurative control identify the body part as a means of mastering the person.
Lowering and placing the forehead on the ground provide a different bodily acknowledgment of dependence.

structural_cues.role: The generic human begins in attachment-bearing material.

structural_cues.quote_ar: كَلَّا لَئِن لَّمْ يَنتَهِ لَنَسْفَعًۢا بِٱلنَّاصِيَةِ
structural_cues.role: Failure to cease is followed by the conditional threat of bodily seizure.
The bodily part bears descriptions of the person's reprehensible conduct, linking the physical hold to moral agency.
The closing command gives a contrasting bodily action joined to approach.

surprising_valid_outliers.mechanism: Attachment, a forelock in a grasp, and a lowered forehead are distinct bodily relations. Read together, the last two replay the focus's lack of bodily self-foundation under opposed conditions of coercion and responsive submission.

changed_reading.after: It can furnish an embodied pattern for later vulnerability and for an intentional acknowledgment of dependence.

surprising_valid_outliers.reader_inference: The attachment, seizure, and prostration images are supplied. Their arrangement as a bodily pattern is reader-created; no verse explicitly calls seizure or prostration a return to عَلَقٍ. The threatened person and commanded addressee need not be the same individual.
surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The surprising move turns a generative attachment into a pattern involving restraint and worship. Its anchors are concrete, but this is neither a prediction encoded in embryonic material nor an identification of clinging, forelock, and forehead as the same anatomical thing.

surprising_valid_outliers.reading: The focus can support a secondary picture of humans as beings capable of attachment and company. The later assembly and devotional approach then expose different orientations for that relational capacity.

focus_anchor.role: Two focus roots supply a possible conjunction of human sociability and attachment beyond the bodily source.

activation_trace.role: Familiar comfort, companionship, and pleasure in proximity supply the human-relational image.
Affection or desire fastening to a heart or person provides attachment in an affective domain.
A gathering and its people give the passage an actual social attachment, here invoked as backing.
Devotional approach supplies another possible orientation of nearness.

structural_cues.role: The literal biological origin remains the base from which the relational image is projected.
The possessive assembly supplies a concrete social relation.
Refusal toward one person is coordinated with a different movement of approach.

surprising_valid_outliers.mechanism: The focus's sociability and affection scopes can project biological attachment into a capacity for relations. The closing social summons and devotional approach give that projection two specific destinations rather than leaving it as an abstract theme of connection.

changed_reading.before: Attachment chiefly conveys the vulnerability of a biological source.
changed_reading.after: It can also image a capacity for company and allegiance whose direction matters, rather than treating every attachment as a defect.

surprising_valid_outliers.reader_inference: Companionship and affective fastening are supplied lexical scopes. Projecting them into a figurative account of human constitution is a reader inference; neither the assembly clause nor the approach command explicitly mentions love. The literal material reading remains primary.
surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because a material مِنْ phrase is allowed an affective and social resonance. It stays anchored in two focus roots and actual relations in the window, but must not become the literal claim that humans were created from romantic love, that all social bonds oppose devotion, or that the assembly and the Lord are interchangeable attachments.

summary.ordinary_reading: The Lord created humankind from عَلَقٍ, ordinarily understood as thick or clotted blood, with a close image of clinging and conception taking hold. The context places that origin beside received teaching, challenges apparent self-sufficiency, directs return to the Lord, and calls for prostration and approach.
coexisting_readings: Material origin and attachment-bearing origin remain distinguishable emphases; neither requires replacing the other with a modern biological specification.
The same human receives existence and knowledge, so the origin can convey care and generosity as well as dependence.
Human origin counters both the claim to independence and the authority of self-regard; social backing does not remove the limitation it exposes.
A shared created beginning permits different moral responses. The closing commands combine refusal of the obstructer with active devotional submission.
Exploratorily, the reading commands' womb-enclosing branch lets biological formation echo the formation of a reader.
Exploratorily, the cherished-object branch beside the generous Lord permits a resonance of value alongside the humbling source material.
Exploratorily, measured formation in the creation root and trimming in the pen root link a fashioned human recipient with a fashioned teaching instrument.
Exploratorily, blood held together at the origin contrasts with the transgression root's blood overflowing its measure.
Exploratorily, the focus noun's ocular-image branch distinguishes the actual created human from a merely pictured self-sufficient human.
Exploratorily, clinging origin, threatened forelock seizure, and prostration form a bodily pattern of dependence under coercive or responsive conditions.
Exploratorily, the two focus roots' companionship and affection scopes let bodily attachment image a human capacity for social and devotional relations.
unresolved_limits: The packet records no source_gaps, and every in-window ayah has rooted occurrence rows. This does not make the inventories exhaustive accounts of Arabic or make every mapped branch a contextual meaning.
Blood, attachment, conception, and the paired leech sense do not resolve a modern embryological stage, attachment mechanism, or claim of animal ancestry.

The self-sufficiency term can concern wealth and practical means as well as a broader claim of independence. The text connects transgression to perceived sufficiency without making the source material or learning its physiological cause.
The conditional referents in 96:11–12 remain live alternatives; no historical participants are identified from outside the window, and the threatened summons are not a narrated battle outcome.
Return to the Lord does not identify the Lord with the material named after مِنْ. Devotional approach does not establish spatial fusion.

All seven outliers are reader-constructed analogies activated by supplied scopes and citable textual relations. They must remain exploratory and must not replace ordinary word senses, conflate distinct root forms, or be presented as proven intentional wordplay.
